comment: Interactive back-swipe for `openhost --nav-demo`. Tap 'General' (0.10/0.18) -> push runs 0.18..0.53 (capture 0.70 = settled detail screen). Left-edge pan from x=10: recognizes after 10pt of horizontal travel, then scrubs the pop 1:1 -- at the 0.90 capture the finger is at x=140, progress p=(140-10)/390=0.333, so the detail view's leading edge sits at 130pt with the scrim at 8%*(1-p). Release at x=220 with ~2000pt/s forward velocity -> completes: a 0.35s critically-damped spring finishes the pop (0.94..1.29); capture 1.50 shows the restored root.
